show.description: Once deeply in love, two souls were torn apart by the cruel hand of fate. Years later, destiny weaves its mysterious threads, bringing them face to face once more. As old emotions resurface and hearts begin to beat in rhythm again, the question lingers—will their love blossom anew, or will fate, once again, play its harsh game and pull them apart?
